title: GLEIF LEI records, CEP lookups, CNAE/Receita code tables and the Portal da Transparencia API (P220 gleif, P234 cep_lookup, P235 cnae_tables, P237 portal_transparencia_api)
notes: Reused: lei, legal_name, address, city, region, country, cnae, legal_nature, company_size, status, provider_chain, cep_uf_hint, data_attribution, sanctions_screening and sanctioned (core and earlier batches); relations located_at, partner and company_of (core). GLEIF relationships are ownership hints, never scope (P220 cond 5); CNAE sector tags are info context, never risk on their own (P235 cond 4).

attributes.lei_summary: one line about the LEI record (P220 cond 6): 'LEI <lei> | <legal name> | <registration status> | updated <date> | direct parent: ... | ultimate parent: ...', or 'no LEI for <CNPJ>' (most Brazilian SMEs have none; never a risk signal)
attributes.lei_record: GLEIF LEI record facts {lei, legal_name, other_names, registration_status (ISSUED/LAPSED/RETIRED...), entity_status, last_update, initial_registration, next_renewal, jurisdiction, registered_at, registered_as, cnpj, legal_form, category, corroboration, bic, legal_address {city, region, country}, golden_copy}
attributes.lei_parents: GLEIF parents of the LEI record {direct {lei, legal_name, jurisdiction, cnpj} | null, direct_exception {category, reason, reason_text} | null, ultimate ..., ultimate_exception ...}: ownership hints only, never scope
attributes.lei_children: first page of GLEIF direct children of the LEI record {count (as reported), shown, truncated, children [{lei, legal_name, jurisdiction, registration_status, cnpj}]} (at most 10): ownership hints only, never scope
attributes.lei_candidates: GLEIF legal entities that only match a name or keyword (hypotheses, never confirmed links) [{lei, legal_name, jurisdiction, registration_status, match}]
attributes.cep_record: normalised CEP record {postal_code (NNNNN-NNN), address, district, city, region (UF), region_iso (BR-UF), country BR, ibge_code, provider, coordinates {lat, lon, label 'CEP centroid (approximate)'} | null}
attributes.ibge_code: 7-digit IBGE municipality code of the CEP's city (IBGE Localidades)
attributes.cep_ddd: DDD (area code) ViaCEP reports for the CEP's municipality (context for phone/address cross-checks)
attributes.uf_mismatch: weak info cross-checks between the UF of a CEP, of a DDD and of a CNPJ record [{check cep_ddd|cep_cnpj|ddd_cnpj, value}]: people and companies move, never raises a score on its own
attributes.cep_reverse_matches: CEPs ViaCEP lists for an analyst-typed address (reverse search, at most 50) [{postal_code, street, district, city, uf}]
attributes.cnae_detail: human-readable CNAE subclass {code, code_formatted, label, class, class_label, group, group_label, division, division_label, section, section_label, sector_tags, lgpd_protected, known, table_version}
attributes.cnae_matches: CNAE subclasses whose description matches an analyst-typed search term [{code_formatted, label, division}] (at most 10)
attributes.sector_tags: info-context sector tags of a CNAE (financial_insurance, payments_crypto, private_security, gambling_betting): never a risk signal on their own; correlation rules may combine them
attributes.cnae_lgpd_protected: bool: the CNAE is in division 94 (unions, religious, political and other associations) and is never a risk signal or an attribute of a natural person (LGPD art. 5 II and 11)
attributes.transparencia_summary: Portal da Transparencia /pessoa-juridica summary flags of a CNPJ {sanctioned_ceis, sanctioned_cnep, sanctioned_cepim, has_contracts, has_agreements, spending_payee, bidder, transfers_payee}
attributes.federal_contracts: federal contracts of a CNPJ supplier (Portal da Transparencia) {count, count_is_lower_bound, total_value, currency BRL, most_recent [<= 5 {number, object, signed, value, situation, organ}], pages, partial}
attributes.federal_agreements: federal agreements (convenios) of a CNPJ grantee (Portal da Transparencia) {count, count_is_lower_bound, total_value, most_recent [<= 5 {number, object, signed, value, situation, organ}]}
attributes.federal_payments: federal payments (despesas, phase 'pagamento') to a CNPJ payee in the current year (Portal da Transparencia) {count, count_is_lower_bound, total_value, currency BRL, year, most_recent [<= 5 {number, signed, value, organ}]}
attributes.cgu_api_sanctions: sanction rows the Portal da Transparencia API returned for the CNPJ, normalised like the CGU bulk files [{list, sanction_id, category, start, end, organ, status, dedup_key}] (source of the sanction detail)

relations.lei_candidate: company name or keyword -> legal entity GLEIF lists for it by name only (a hypothesis, never a confirmed link; expand=False)
